what: Labelled sentences for the evidence layer's sentence gate (tibi.sentence_gate), audit F03/F07. 'expect' is what a person judged correct before the gate was run on this set: block (unsupported, must not be spoken) or allow (a faithful restatement). 'origin' says who wrote the case: 'audit' cases come from the independent audit of 27 September 2026; 'fix' cases were written by Claude with the fix, so they are not independent of it. Results are reported as measured, including misses.

deployment.title: Deployment
deployment.text: OpsAtlas runs locally on one machine. Deployment to 10 teams takes 2 weeks. Single sign-on is not included in the proof of concept; it is planned for a real deployment.

answers.title: How answers work
answers.text: OpsAtlas answers only from approved documents and cites the sections it used. It refuses when the approved evidence does not support an answer.

commercial.title: Commercial position
